scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" -n "backend,frontend" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" -n "backend,frontend" "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
